messages:
elisabeth: Dropping a quick UX check-in for the in-console docs panel I sketched. Fig link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc. Main Q: should the panel open on click or hover? Hover feels discoverable but causes accidental opens. Thoughts?
sam: Click. Hover is a nightmare on mobile and with trackpads. Click gives a clear focus target for keyboard users.
rahul: Agree click. Also we need to expose aria-expanded and role=dialog, and provide a short heading announcement for SRs like 'Console docs: routing'.
elisabeth: Good call. Linking into docs: do we prefer deep-fragment anchors (`/docs/console#caching`) or query params (`/docs/console?src=panel&topic=caching`)?
sam: Use fragment anchors for human-friendliness. Add a lightweight query param for telemetry: `/docs/console?src=panel#caching`. Make sure order is `?` then `#`.
rahul: Minor accessibility nit: link should open in a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer" and have an aria-label that mentions it opens a new tab. Also visible focus ring in the design system token.
docs-bot: Note: docs heading-id PR merged yesterday: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/355.
elisabeth: Copy: current CTA is 'Learn more' which QA flagged as vague. Options: 'Open docs', 'See caching guide', 'Read more about caching'. Which do we prefer?
sam: Prefer contextual CTA when we can: 'See caching guide'. If no clear heading, fallback to 'Open docs'.
rahul: +1. Also show a tiny external-link icon next to any link that leaves the console. @sam can you add a 12px icon and a token?
sam: Yep, will add icon and update docs-link component to emit `docs.link.clicked` event with props {source: 'panel', anchor: 'caching'}. We'll ensure prop values are safe (no user PII).
elisabeth: Should the panel persist open when navigating between console routes? I think nocontext is route-specific. But restore on refresh might be ok.
sam: Close on route change to keep things simple. Persist on refresh only.
rahul: I'll add NVDA checks to the PR and include the aria copy.
elisabeth: Thanks all, I'll update the ticket and the Figma. :thumbsup:
summary: UX thread deciding click-to-open for the in-console docs panel, accessibility requirements (aria-expanded, role, focus ring, screen-reader heading), anchor vs query param link strategy (use fragment anchors + src param), CTA copy preference for contextual CTAs with fallback, external-link icon and telemetry event, and panel persistence behavior (close on navigation, restore on refresh). Mentions docs PR merge and next steps for design and a11y testing.
